scientific_integrity: Exact formal generating-function proof for all integral run bounds, with executable finite checks of coefficients and the defining scattered-subsequence condition; known unrestricted case is credited as prior.
scientific_limitations: The alphabet is binary and only zero runs have a fixed upper bound. The moment estimate takes word length to infinity at fixed run bound. Independent checking and exhaustive literature coverage are not asserted.
title: Exact subsequence-universality law under a bounded zero-run constraint
